validation.notes: Repaired migrateSessionsFromAgentRoot() in packages/coding-agent/src/migrations.ts: the unconditional renameSync(file, newPath) (carrying the injected '// Existing destinations are incorrectly overwritten. // Skip if target exists' comment where the guard had been removed) was replaced with a minimal `if (existsSync(newPath)) continue;` guard, so an existing destination always wins and neither copy is overwritten or deleted; the loop still migrates unrelated legacy sessions. .prale-eval/regression.mjs loads the real module through .prale-eval/subject.mjs loadMigrations() with getAgentDir() pointed at a fresh mkdtemp agent dir and uses real fs. It seeds a legacy agent-root .jsonl whose already-migrated destination exists, plus a second unrelated legacy .jsonl, runs migrateSessionsFromAgentRoot(), and asserts: (1) the pre-existing destination is byte-for-byte unchanged, (2) the colliding legacy source still exists with its original bytes (not moved, not deleted), (3) the unrelated session is moved out of the agent root and arrives intact in sessions/<encoded-cwd>/, and (4) a second run is idempotent. Run from the workspace root it exits 0 with the fix. Fault sensitivity was verified on an isolated copy of the workspace holding the original faulty migrations.ts: the same script failed with 'AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: existing destination must never be overwritten by a colliding legacy session' (exit 1). Limitation: the repository has no installed node_modules, so the project's vitest suite and tsc typecheck were not runnable offline and were not used; the standalone Node 24 regression above is the focused validation and needs no dependencies or network.

citations.claim: Faulty collision policy: legacy session file was renamed onto an existing destination because the existsSync guard was removed, overwriting the destination.
Repair: skip migration when the destination already exists, leaving both copies untouched while other files still migrate.
Regression exercising the repaired production code with real fs and a caller-owned temporary agent directory.
